description_en: An API operation that uploads credential images, including utility bills and credit card statements, and uses Qwen-VL to intelligently fetch billing addresses and names
description_zh: API接口，上传凭证图片，包括：水电煤、信用卡账单等，通过通义VL智能提取账单地址及姓名
kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth-intl credential-recognition-intl --product-code CREDENTIAL_RECOGNITION --doc-type 01 --ocr-area 0101 --fraud-check true --region cn-hangzhou
name: CredentialRecognitionIntl

parameters.help_en: The product solution to use. Set this to CREDENTIAL_RECOGNITION
parameters.help_zh: 要接入的产品方案。取值CREDENTIAL_RECOGNITION
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded image. If you choose to pass in the image by using IdOcrPictureBase64 (Base64-encoded photo), check the photo size and do not pass in an excessively large photo
parameters.help_zh: 图片Base64编码。如果您选择IdOcrPictureBase64（照片Base64编码）方式传入照片，请注意检查照片大小，不要传入过大的照片
parameters.name: credential_ocr_picture_base64

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. The URL must be a publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS link
parameters.help_zh: 图片地址，公网可访问的HTTP、HTTPS链接
parameters.name: credential_ocr_picture_url

parameters.help_en:
The credential type.
Transaction credential: 01 (includes various electronic bill images such as water, electricity, gas, and credit card bills)
parameters.help_zh:
凭证类型。
交易凭据：01（包括：水、电、煤、信用卡等各类电子账单图片）
parameters.name: doc_type

parameters.help_en:
The extraction type:
0101: Electronic bill address and name module (extracts address and name through intelligent analysis)
parameters.help_zh:
提取类型：
0101：电子账单地址&姓名模块（通过智能分析提取地址及姓名模块）
parameters.name: ocr_area

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable tampering detection. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启篡改检测
true：开启
false：关闭
parameters.name: fraud_check

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable quality detection. Valid values: Y (enabled) and N (disabled)
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启质量检测 Y: 开启, N: 关闭
parameters.name: id_quality

parameters.help_en: The field check rule configuration, in JSON string format
parameters.help_zh: 字段校验规则配置，JSON字符串
parameters.name: check_rule_config

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable OCR result standardization. Valid values: 0 (disabled) and 1 (enabled)
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启OCR结果标准化 0: 关闭, 1: 开启
parameters.name: ocr_value_standard

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable translation. Valid values: 0 (disabled) and 1 (enabled)
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启翻译 0: 关闭, 1: 开启
parameters.name: ocr_translation

ExtIdInfo.description_en: The key information extracted from the credential, in JSON format

SubCode.description_en: The description of the authentication result

Success.description_en:
The extraction result. Valid values:
S: Successful.
F: Failed
Success.description_zh:
提取结果。取值：
S：成功。
F：失败
